schema_data.name: Adapted Cantrip
schema_data.benefit: Choose one cantrip from the arcane, divine, occult, or primal spell list. You can cast this spelled as an innate spell at will.

schema_data.name: Cooperative Nature
schema_data.benefit: Aid grants a +5 circumstance bonus to skill checks instead of +2, and a +2 circumstance bonus to attack rolls or AC instead of +1.

schema_data.name: General Training
schema_data.benefit: You gain one 1st-level general feat.

schema_data.name: Haughty Obstinacy
schema_data.benefit: +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against mental effects. On a success, the effect source is temporarily immune to further attempts for 10 minutes.

schema_data.name: Natural Ambition
schema_data.benefit: You gain a 1st-level class feat for your class.

schema_data.name: Natural Skill
schema_data.benefit: You gain training in two skills of your choice.

schema_data.name: Unconventional Weaponry
schema_data.benefit: Choose one uncommon weapon. You gain access to that weapon and become trained in that weapon.

schema_data.name: Dwarven Lore
schema_data.benefit: Trained in Crafting and Religion. Gain Crafting Lore and Dwarven Lore.

schema_data.name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained with the battle axe, pick, and warhammer, and all dwarf weapons. For proficiency, treat martial dwarf weapons as simple, and advanced dwarf weapons as martial.

schema_data.name: Rock Runner
schema_data.benefit: You can ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble and uneven ground made of stone and earth. You are not flat-footed when Balancing on uneven or slippery stone. Acrobatics DC to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground made of stone or earth is reduced by 2.

schema_data.name: Stonecunning
schema_data.benefit: +2 circumstance bonus on Perception checks to notice unusual stonework. When not Seeking, you get a check to find unusual stonework when you pass within 10 feet of it.

schema_data.name: Unburdened Iron
schema_data.benefit: Ignore the reduction to Speed from wearing armor and reduce the encumbered speed penalty from 5 feet to only 0 feet.

schema_data.name: Vengeful Hatred
schema_data.benefit: Choose drow, duergar, giant, or orc when you take this feat. +1 circumstance damage per weapon die against creatures with that trait.

schema_data.name: Ancestral Longevity
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in one skill of your choice. Once per day after rest, you can switch which skill you are trained in.

schema_data.name: Elven Lore
schema_data.benefit: Trained in Arcana and Nature. Gain Elven Lore skill.

schema_data.name: Elven Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained with longbows, composite longbows, longswords, rapiers, shortbows, and composite shortbows. For proficiency, treat martial elf weapons as simple, and advanced elf weapons as martial.

schema_data.name: Forlorn
schema_data.benefit: +1 circumstance bonus on saving throws against emotion effects. If you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

schema_data.name: Nimble Elf
schema_data.benefit: Your Speed increases to 35 feet.

schema_data.name: Otherworldly Magic
schema_data.benefit: Choose one cantrip from the primal spell list. You can cast it as a primal innate spell at will.

schema_data.name: Unwavering Mien
schema_data.benefit: When you roll a success on a saving throw against a mental effect, you critically succeed instead.

schema_data.name: Animal Accomplice
schema_data.benefit: You gain a familiar. If you retrain this feat, you lose the familiar.

schema_data.name: Burrow Elocutionist
schema_data.benefit: You can speak with burrowing animals (badgers, moles, rabbits, etc.). This doesn't make them friendly.

schema_data.name: Fey Fellowship
schema_data.benefit: +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks against fey creatures; +2 circumstance bonus to all saving throws against fey creatures. Bonuses apply only when the opposing entity has the fey creature-type tag. Multiple circumstance bonuses vs. fey do not stack (only highest applies). In a social encounter involving a fey creature, you may attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression as a 1-action activity (immediate, no 1-minute conversation required), but the check takes a –5 penalty. If the immediate check fails, you may still attempt the normal 1-minute conversation retry with no further penalty from this feat. If you also have the Glad-Hand skill feat and the target is a fey creature, the –5 penalty on the immediate Diplomacy check is waived.

glad_hand_interaction.effect: Waives the –5 penalty on the immediate Diplomacy check.

schema_data.name: First World Magic
schema_data.benefit: Choose one primal cantrip. You can cast it as a primal innate spell at will.

schema_data.name: Gnome Obsession
schema_data.benefit: Pick a Lore skill subcategory. You become trained in that Lore skill (or an expert if already trained). During downtime, if you perform a task connected to your obsession, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to any related skill checks.

schema_data.name: Gnome Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: Trained with glaive and kukri. For proficiency, treat martial gnome weapons as simple, advanced gnome weapons as martial.

schema_data.name: Illusion Sense
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against illusions and to Perception checks to disbelieve illusions. When you move into an area with an illusion you can see, you automatically attempt a Perception check to disbelieve it (no action required).

schema_data.name: Natural Performer
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in Performance. Choose one specialization at character creation: singing, dancing, or acting. When you use Perform with your chosen specialization, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to the check.

schema_data.name: Vibrant Display
schema_data.benefit: You spend 2 actions to display a dazzling burst of vivid coloration. All creatures within 10 feet that can see you must attempt a Will save (DC = 10 + your Charisma modifier + your level). Failure: the creature becomes fascinated by you until the end of your next turn. Success: no effect. Creatures are then temporarily immune to this effect for 1 minute.

schema_data.name: First World Adept
schema_data.prerequisites: At least one primal innate spell
schema_data.benefit: You gain faerie fire and invisibility as 2nd-level primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

schema_data.name: Vivacious Conduit
schema_data.benefit: If you rest for 10 minutes, you regain Hit Points equal to your Constitution modifier × half your level. This is cumulative with any healing you receive from Treat Wounds.

schema_data.name: Gnome Weapon Specialist
schema_data.benefit: Whenever you critically hit with a glaive, kukri, or any weapon with the gnome trait, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

schema_data.name: Gnome Weapon Expertise
schema_data.benefit: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in all gnome weapons in which you are trained.

schema_data.name: Burn It!
schema_data.benefit: Fire damage you deal with non-magical weapons and alchemical items gains a +1 status bonus. Resistance to your fire damage is reduced by an amount equal to half your level (minimum 1).

schema_data.name: City Scavenger
schema_data.benefit: You know the urban environment intimately. You can Subsist using Society or Survival in a settlement. You can use Society in place of Survival to Track and Seek in urban environments.

schema_data.name: Goblin Lore
schema_data.benefit: Trained in Nature and Stealth. Gain Goblin Lore skill.

schema_data.name: Goblin Scuttle
schema_data.benefit: When an ally ends a move action adjacent to you, you can Step as a reaction.

schema_data.name: Goblin Song
schema_data.benefit: You sing annoying songs. Attempt a Performance check against the Will DC of a single enemy within 30 feet. Success imposes frightened 1, critical success frightened 2. Target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

schema_data.name: Goblin Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: Trained with dogslicers and horsechoppers. For proficiency, treat martial goblin weapons as simple, advanced goblin weapons as martial.

schema_data.name: Goblin Weapon Frenzy
schema_data.benefit: Whenever you score a critical hit using a goblin weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

schema_data.name: Junk Tinker
schema_data.benefit: Trained in Crafting. You can Craft nonmagical items from junk. Crafting DCs for such items are 5 easier, but items are shoddy (break on failed attack/check).

schema_data.name: Very Sneaky
schema_data.benefit: You can move 5 feet farther when you take the Sneak action, up to your Speed. You don't become Observed at the end of a Sneak action if you lack cover or concealment, as long as you have cover, greater cover, or concealment at the end of your turn.

schema_data.name: Distracting Shadows
schema_data.benefit: You have a knack for avoiding notice. You can use creatures one or more sizes larger than you as cover for Hide and Sneak checks.

schema_data.name: Halfling Lore
schema_data.benefit: Trained in Acrobatics and Stealth. Gain Halfling Lore skill.

schema_data.name: Halfling Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: Trained with sling and halfling sling staff. For proficiency, treat martial halfling weapons as simple, advanced halfling weapons as martial.

schema_data.name: Sure Feet
schema_data.benefit: You can attempt Acrobatics checks to Balance on narrow surfaces and uneven ground without rolling. On a critical failure, you succeed instead.

schema_data.name: Titan Slinger
schema_data.benefit: Your thrown weapons and sling range increment increased by 10 feet. Increases to 20 feet at 13th level.

schema_data.name: Unfettered Halfling
schema_data.benefit: Success on a check to Escape is automatically a critical success. +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Escape.

schema_data.name: Halfling Resolve
schema_data.benefit: When you succeed on a saving throw against an emotion effect, treat it as a critical success. If you also have the Gutsy Halfling heritage, critical failures on emotion saving throws become failures instead.

schema_data.name: Ceaseless Shadows
schema_data.benefit: You no longer need cover or concealment to Hide or Sneak. When creatures would grant you lesser cover, you gain full cover instead and can Take Cover against those creatures. When creatures would grant you full cover, you gain greater cover instead.

schema_data.name: Halfling Weapon Expertise
schema_data.benefit: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in a given weapon or weapons, you also gain that proficiency in the sling, halfling sling staff, shortsword, and all halfling weapons in which you are trained.

schema_data.name: Catfolk Lore
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in Acrobatics and Stealth, and gain Catfolk Lore.

schema_data.name: Catfolk Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained with traditional catfolk weapons and treat martial catfolk weapons as simple for proficiency.

schema_data.name: Graceful Step
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks to Balance and Tumble Through.

schema_data.name: Feline Eyes
schema_data.benefit: Your low-light vision sharpens; checks relying on sight in dim conditions gain a +1 circumstance bonus.

schema_data.name: Well-Groomed
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression in social settings where appearance matters.

schema_data.name: Cat Nap
schema_data.benefit: You require less downtime for light rest and can recover from short rests more efficiently.

schema_data.name: Elf Atavism
schema_data.benefit: You gain one elf ancestry feat for which you meet the prerequisites.

schema_data.name: Forlorn Half-Elf
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects and can treat one success each day as a critical success.

schema_data.name: Multitalented
schema_data.benefit: You gain training in one skill and one additional language of your choice.

schema_data.name: Mixed Heritage Adaptability
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to one trained skill of your choice; you can change it after daily preparations.

schema_data.name: Elven Instincts
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative rolls and Perception checks to Seek.

schema_data.name: Cross-Cultural Upbringing
schema_data.benefit: You gain Society training and can use Society to Recall Knowledge about either human or elven communities.

schema_data.name: Orc Atavism
schema_data.benefit: You gain one orc ancestry feat for which you meet the prerequisites.

schema_data.name: Feral Endurance
schema_data.benefit: Once per day when reduced to 0 HP, you remain at 1 HP and become wounded 1.

schema_data.name: Intimidating Glare
schema_data.benefit: You can Demoralize a target without sharing a language.

schema_data.name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained in iconic orc weapons and treat martial orc weapons as simple for proficiency.

schema_data.name: Scar-Thickened
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saves against persistent bleed and poison effects.

schema_data.name: Unyielding Will
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects.

schema_data.name: Kobold Lore
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in Crafting and Stealth and gain Kobold Lore.

schema_data.name: Snare Setter
schema_data.benefit: You can craft and deploy simple snares more quickly, reducing setup time.

schema_data.name: Draconic Ties
schema_data.benefit: Choose a draconic damage type; gain minor resistance to that type.

schema_data.name: Tunnel Runner
schema_data.benefit: You ignore movement penalties from cramped underground passages and gain +2 to Acrobatics checks to Squeeze.

schema_data.name: Draconic Scout
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to initiative and Survival checks when underground.

schema_data.name: Kobold Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained with traditional kobold weapons and treat martial kobold weapons as simple for proficiency.

schema_data.name: Leshy Lore
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in Nature and Diplomacy and gain Leshy Lore.

schema_data.name: Seedpod
schema_data.benefit: You can produce and throw small seed pods as a minor ranged natural attack.

schema_data.name: Photosynthetic Recovery
schema_data.benefit: When resting in natural sunlight, you recover additional Hit Points.

schema_data.name: Rooted Resilience
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus against forced movement and effects that would knock you prone.

schema_data.name: Verdant Voice
schema_data.benefit: You can communicate simple intent with common plants and gain +1 to Nature checks to influence plant creatures.

schema_data.name: Forest Step
schema_data.benefit: You ignore difficult terrain caused by natural undergrowth.

schema_data.name: Ratfolk Lore
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in Society and Thievery and gain Ratfolk Lore.

schema_data.name: Cheek Pouches
schema_data.benefit: You can stow and retrieve a small held item more efficiently each round.

schema_data.name: Tunnel Vision
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to detect movement in narrow corridors and tunnels.

schema_data.name: Scrounger
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Crafting checks to Repair and to checks to Subsist in settlements.

schema_data.name: Communal Instinct
schema_data.benefit: When adjacent to an ally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against fear.

schema_data.name: Ratfolk Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained with traditional ratfolk weapons and treat martial ratfolk weapons as simple for proficiency.

schema_data.name: Tengu Lore
schema_data.benefit: You become trained in Acrobatics and Deception and gain Tengu Lore.

schema_data.name: One-Toed Hop
schema_data.benefit: Your mobility training grants a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Balance and Leap.

schema_data.name: Squawk
schema_data.benefit: You can emit a harsh cry to Demoralize; targets are temporarily immune for 1 hour after you use this effect.

schema_data.name: Sky-Bridge Runner
schema_data.benefit: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Acrobatics checks while traversing narrow or elevated surfaces.

schema_data.name: Beak Adept
schema_data.benefit: Your beak Strike gains improved handling and a +1 circumstance bonus to Disarm attempts.

schema_data.name: Tengu Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: You are trained with traditional tengu weapons and treat martial tengu weapons as simple for proficiency.

schema_data.name: Hold-Scarred Orc
schema_data.benefit: Trained in Stealth. Gain the Terrain Stalker feat for underground terrain. If you retrain out of this feat, you lose Terrain Stalker.

schema_data.name: Orc Ferocity
schema_data.benefit: Once per day when reduced to 0 HP, you remain at 1 HP and become wounded 1 (or increase your wounded by 1).

schema_data.name: Orc Sight
schema_data.benefit: Your low-light vision is replaced with darkvision.

schema_data.name: Orc Superstition
schema_data.benefit: +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against magic. If you succeed at a save against a magical effect, treat it as a critical success instead (once per day).

schema_data.name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
schema_data.benefit: Trained with the falchion and greataxe. For proficiency, treat martial orc weapons as simple, advanced orc weapons as martial.

schema_data.name: Orc Weapon Carnage
schema_data.benefit: When you critically succeed at an attack roll with an orc weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

schema_data.name: Double Slice
schema_data.benefit: You lash out at your foe with both weapons. Make two Strikes, one with each of your two melee weapons, each using your current multiple attack penalty. Both Strikes must have the same target. If the second Strike hits, combine their damage for the purposes of resistances and weaknesses. Apply your multiple attack penalty to the Strikes normally.

schema_data.name: Exacting Strike
schema_data.benefit: You make a controlled attack, fully accounting for your momentum. Make a melee Strike. It counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike fails, you don't increase your multiple attack penalty.

schema_data.name: Point-Blank Shot
schema_data.benefit: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly. When using a ranged volley weapon while in this stance, you don't take the penalty for attacking within the weapon's volley range. When using a ranged weapon that doesn't have the volley trait, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to damage rolls on attacks against targets within the weapon's first range increment.

schema_data.name: Power Attack
schema_data.benefit: You unleash a particularly powerful attack that clobbers your foe but leaves you a bit unbalanced. Make a melee Strike. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty. If this Strike hits, you deal an extra die of weapon damage.

schema_data.name: Reactive Shield
schema_data.benefit: Trigger: An enemy hits you with a melee Strike. You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second. You immediately use the Raise a Shield action and gain your shield's bonus to AC. The circumstance bonus applies to your AC when you're determining the outcome of the triggering attack.

schema_data.name: Snagging Strike
schema_data.benefit: You combine an attack with quick grappling moves to throw an enemy off balance as long as it stays in your reach. Make a Strike while wielding a weapon with the two-hand trait, using only one hand. If this Strike hits and deals damage, the target is flat-footed until the start of your next turn.

schema_data.name: Sudden Charge
schema_data.benefit: 2 actions. With a quick sprint, you dash up to your foe and swing. Stride twice. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You can use Sudden Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

schema_data.name: Nimble Dodge
schema_data.benefit: Trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker. You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.

schema_data.name: Trap Finder
schema_data.benefit: You have an intuitive sense that alerts you to the dangers and presence of traps. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to find traps, to AC against attacks made by traps, and to saves against traps. You can find traps that require legendary proficiency in Perception. If you critically fail a check to Disable a Device on a trap, you don't trigger it.

schema_data.name: Twin Feint
schema_data.benefit: You make a dazzling series of attacks with both weapons, using the first attack to throw your foe off guard against a second attack. Make one Strike with each of your two melee weapons, both against the same target. The target is automatically flat-footed against the second attack.

schema_data.name: You're Next
schema_data.benefit: Trigger: You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points. After downing a foe, you menace another to sow fear. Attempt an Intimidation check with a +2 circumstance bonus to Demoralize a single creature that you can see and that can see you. This creature doesn't need to be within 30 feet, but it must be able to perceive the creature you just killed.

schema_data.name: Eldritch Trickster Racket
schema_data.benefit: You blend arcane power with criminal cunning. You gain a free multiclass spellcasting archetype dedication at 1st level. You can select the Magical Trickster feat at 2nd level (instead of 4th). Intelligence is your key ability score.

schema_data.name: Mastermind Racket
schema_data.benefit: You use cunning deduction rather than brute force. Intelligence is your key ability score. You gain training in Society and one additional knowledge skill. When you successfully Recall Knowledge about a creature, it is flat-footed against your attacks until the start of your next turn. On a critical success, it is flat-footed for 1 minute.

schema_data.name: Counterspell
schema_data.benefit:
Trigger: A creature Casts a Spell that you have prepared. When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own magic to counter it. You expend a prepared spell to counter the triggering creature's casting of that same spell. You lose your spell slot as if you had cast 

the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

schema_data.name: Eschew Materials
schema_data.benefit: You can use clever workarounds to replicate the arcane essence of certain materials. When Casting a Spell that requires material components, you can provide these material components without a spell component pouch by drawing intricate replacement sigils in the air. Unlike when providing somatic components, you still must have a hand completely free. This doesn't remove the need for any materials listed in the spell's cost entry.

schema_data.name: Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting. You gain a familiar.

schema_data.name: Hand of the Apprentice
schema_data.benefit: You can magically hurl your weapon at your foe. You gain the Hand of the Apprentice arcane school spell. If you don't already have one, you gain a focus pool of 1 Focus Point, which you can Refocus by studying your spellbook.

schema_data.name: Reach Spell
schema_data.benefit: You extend your spell's range. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.

schema_data.name: Widen Spell
schema_data.benefit: You manipulate the energy of your spell, causing it to affect a wider area. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst that normally has a radius of at least 10 feet (a burst with a smaller radius is not affected). Add 5 feet to the length of a cone or line that is normally 15 feet long or smaller, and add 10 feet to the length of a larger cone or line.

schema_data.name: Staff Nexus Thesis
schema_data.benefit: Your arcane thesis focuses on the creation and empowerment of magical staves. You begin play with a makeshift staff containing 1 cantrip and 1 first-level spell from your spellbook. The makeshift staff gains charges only by expending spell slots (1 slot = number of spell levels in charges). At 8th level you may expend 2 slots per day; at 16th level up to 3 slots. You can Craft the makeshift staff into any standard staff type at standard cost, retaining the two original spells.

schema_data.name: Cantrip Expansion
schema_data.benefit: Add 2 additional arcane cantrips to your spellbook and gain the ability to prepare them each day. These cantrips do not count against your prepared cantrip limit.

schema_data.name: Conceal Spell
schema_data.benefit: Your next action is to Cast a Spell. The spell gains the subtle trait, making its manifestations invisible to observers. Creatures who succeed on Perception vs your Arcana DC realize you are casting a spell.

schema_data.name: Enhanced Familiar
schema_data.benefit: Your familiar gains 2 additional familiar abilities each level. It also becomes more resilient: add your Intelligence modifier to its Hit Point total.

schema_data.name: Nonlethal Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, that spell deals nonlethal damage. This doesn't work on spells that already deal nonlethal damage or on spells that don't deal damage.

schema_data.name: Bespell Weapon
schema_data.benefit: After Casting a non-cantrip arcane spell, your held weapon crackles with magical energy until the end of the current turn. Your next Strike with that weapon deals 1d6 extra damage of the spell's trait (if applicable) or 1d6 force damage.

schema_data.name: Linked Focus
schema_data.prerequisites: Focus pool (arcane school or Hand of the Apprentice)
schema_data.benefit: When you cast an arcane spell from a spell slot, you also recover 1 Focus Point (up to your pool maximum). You may only regain 1 Focus Point this way per round.

schema_data.name: Spell Penetration
schema_data.benefit: Your spells are harder to resist. Targets take a -2 circumstance penalty to their saving throw or check to counteract your spells.

schema_data.name: Steady Spellcasting
schema_data.benefit: Confidence in your spellcasting helps you maintain concentration. When a reaction or free action would disrupt your spellcasting, attempt a DC 15 flat check. On a success, the spell is not disrupted.

schema_data.name: Advanced School Spell
schema_data.benefit: Gain an additional focus spell from your arcane school. Add it to your focus pool. Each time you Cast this spell, you gain a small benefit depending on your school (see ARCANE_SCHOOLS).

schema_data.name: Bond Conservation
schema_data.benefit: When the next action you use is to Cast a 1-action or 2-action spell, you can Drain Bonded Item as part of the same activity. If the spell level is lower than your highest-level spell slot, you recover an additional lower-level spell slot as well.

schema_data.name: Universal Versatility
schema_data.prerequisites: Universalist wizard, Hand of the Apprentice
schema_data.benefit: Your command of all schools lets you borrow minor school benefits. Once per day you can gain the trained school spell of any one arcane school and cast it using your focus pool.

schema_data.name: Greater Mental Evolution
schema_data.benefit: Your arcane mind expands. Add 2 additional arcane spells of your choice to your spellbook. These spells do not cost gold. Additionally, your Intelligence modifier is added to initiative rolls.

schema_data.name: Overwhelming Energy
schema_data.benefit: The next spell you Cast deals energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic). Targets take a -5 circumstance penalty to any resistance they have against that damage type.

schema_data.name: Quickened Casting
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, if your next action is to Cast an arcane spell that normally takes 2 actions, you may instead cast it with 1 action. You can't use this feat again until the next time you prepare spells.

schema_data.name: Scroll Savant
schema_data.benefit: During your daily preparations, you can craft two temporary scrolls of arcane spells from your spellbook, of any rank you can prepare. These scrolls are usable only by you and expire at the next daily preparation.

schema_data.name: Clever Counterspell
schema_data.benefit: When using Counterspell, instead of needing to have the same spell prepared, you can expend any prepared spell of the same or higher rank from your spellbook to attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

schema_data.name: Magic Sense
schema_data.benefit: You have a constant, subtle sense for magic. You always detect when a spell is cast within 30 feet (like constant Detect Magic), though not necessarily the school or details.

schema_data.name: Reflect Spell
schema_data.benefit: When you successfully counteract a spell with Counterspell, you can redirect the spell back at its caster. The original caster becomes the new target of their own spell.

schema_data.name: Effortless Concentration
schema_data.benefit: The next spell you cast gains a Sustained duration. You can Sustain it with a free action (instead of an action). This applies once per spell cast with this feat.

schema_data.name: Alter Reality
schema_data.benefit: You can subtly manipulate the world around you. Once per day, cast a Wish-like effect with the following restrictions: duplicate the effect of any arcane spell of 7th rank or lower without expending a spell slot.

schema_data.name: Spell Combination
schema_data.benefit: Once per day during preparation, combine two prepared spells of the same rank into a dual-spell slot. When cast, both effects occur simultaneously, but you spend only one slot.

schema_data.name: Infinite Eye
schema_data.benefit: You can perceive magical auras at will. As a free action, you gain Truesight with a 30-foot range for 1 round. Use this ability up to 3 times per day.

schema_data.name: Reprepare Spell
schema_data.benefit: Three times per day, as a 10-minute activity, you can reprepare any one spell from your spellbook into an empty or expended spell slot of the appropriate rank.

schema_data.name: Infinite Possibilities
schema_data.benefit: During your daily preparations, add up to 3 spells from any tradition (not just arcane) to your spellbook as temporary entries. These entries expire at next daily prep, and the spells are treated as arcane spells while prepared from them.

schema_data.name: Spell Mastery
schema_data.benefit: Choose 4 arcane spells of rank 9 or lower in your spellbook. These spells are permanently prepared — you can cast each once per day without them counting against your prepared spell slots. On subsequent castings in the same day, use normal spell slots.

schema_data.name: Metamagic Mastery
schema_data.benefit: Any metamagic feat you apply to a spell does not count as an additional action. You can apply two metamagic feats to the same spell, though each still requires its own action if specified.

schema_data.name: Animal Companion
schema_data.benefit: You gain the service of a young animal companion that travels with you and obeys your commands. The rules for animal companions appear on page 214.

schema_data.name: Crossbow Ace
schema_data.benefit: Your extensive practice with the crossbow has helped you develop an eye for trajectory. When you use a crossbow, the Quick Draw action also reloads the crossbow. When your crossbow is loaded, you can reload without drawing weapon hand.

schema_data.name: Hunted Shot
schema_data.benefit: You carefully track a target and then launch two arrows in rapid succession. Make two Strikes against your prey with your ranged weapon, or one Strike if your weapon has the volley trait. If both hit, combine their damage for resistances and weaknesses. Apply your multiple attack penalty to both. This attack counts as two attacks for your multiple attack penalty.

schema_data.name: Monster Hunter
schema_data.benefit: You swear to hunt down a specific type of creature. Choose one of the following monster types: aberration, animal, beast, construct, dragon, elemental, fey, fungus, giant, humanoid, ooze, or undead. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Recall Knowledge checks and Investigation checks against creatures with this trait.

schema_data.name: Twin Takedown
schema_data.benefit: You swiftly move from one opponent to the next. Make two Strikes, each against a different target and with a different weapon. The second Strike takes the normal multiple attack penalty, but the Double Slice ability applies.

schema_data.name: Bardic Lore
schema_data.benefit: Gain the Bardic Lore special ability: make a Lore check on any topic even if untrained, using your occultism proficiency rank for the DC. You can also roll twice and take the better result for Lore checks.

schema_data.name: Lingering Composition
schema_data.benefit: When casting a cantrip composition with 1-round duration, attempt a Performance check. Success: 3-round duration; critical success: 4-round duration; failure: 1-round duration; critical failure: immediately ends.

schema_data.name: Versatile Performance
schema_data.benefit: Use Performance in place of Diplomacy to Make an Impression, Deception to lie, or Intimidation to Demoralize. You can also swap one signature spell once per day without leveling up.

schema_data.name: Cantrip Expansion
schema_data.benefit: Increase the number of cantrips in your spell repertoire by 2.

schema_data.name: Esoteric Polymath
schema_data.benefit: Add any common spell from any tradition to your repertoire as a signature spell; you can cast it at the same spell rank it appears in your repertoire. Swap this spell once per day for another.

schema_data.name: Inspire Competence
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Composition cantrip: one ally in 60-ft emanation gains a +2 status bonus to a skill check attempted before the end of your next turn. Sustained up to 1 minute.

schema_data.name: Melodious Spell
schema_data.benefit: The next spell you cast this turn loses the manipulate trait, gains the auditory trait, and does not require a free hand for somatic components.

schema_data.name: Triple Time
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Composition cantrip: all allies in 60-ft emanation gain a +10-foot status bonus to Speed for as long as you Sustain the Cantrip.

schema_data.name: Versatile Signature
schema_data.benefit: Swap your designated signature spells once per day during your daily preparations (instead of only on level-up).

schema_data.name: Dirge of Doom
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Composition cantrip: all enemies in 30-ft emanation become frightened 1. Sustained up to 1 minute; enemies become frightened 1 each turn they end within the aura.

schema_data.name: Harmonize
schema_data.benefit: The next spell you cast this turn is a composition spell: it does not end any currently active composition. You can have two compositions active simultaneously.

schema_data.name: Steady Spellcasting
schema_data.benefit: If a reaction would disrupt a spell you are Casting, roll a DC 15 flat check; on a success, the spell is not disrupted.

schema_data.name: Inspire Heroics
schema_data.benefit: The next action is to cast Inspire Courage or Inspire Competence. Roll Performance against the composition DC; success: the bonus from that composition increases by 1; critical success: the bonus increases by 2.

schema_data.name: House of Imaginary Walls
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Composition cantrip: create an imaginary 10-ft wall adjacent to you; creatures who fail their Will save treat it as a solid barrier for 1 round.

schema_data.name: Quickened Casting
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, reduce the casting time of your next 1-action or 2-action occult spell by 1 action (minimum 1 action). If you used a 10th-level slot, this feat cannot apply to it.

schema_data.name: Eclectic Skill
schema_data.benefit: Treat all skills as if you were trained in them (use Versatile Performance for skill checks you are not trained in). Additionally, your untrained improvisation reduces DCs for all non-Lore skills.

schema_data.name: Inspire Defense
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Composition cantrip: all allies in 60-ft emanation gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws while you Sustain the Cantrip.

schema_data.name: Soothing Ballad
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Focus spell: all allies in 30-ft emanation gain healing equal to 1d8 + Charisma modifier and the effects of soothe's counteract attempt (vs fear effects). Heightened (+1): healing increases by 1d8.

schema_data.name: Unusual Composition
schema_data.benefit: Your next action is to cast a composition that normally requires a visual component: you can replace the visual trigger with an auditory trigger or vice versa.

schema_data.name: Eclectic Polymath
schema_data.benefit: When casting the signature spell granted by Esoteric Polymath, you do not need to cast it spontaneously; it functions as if prepared at any rank you have.

schema_data.name: Inspire Magnificence
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Composition cantrip: all allies in 60-ft emanation gain a +2 status bonus to skill checks and saves against magic while you Sustain. On a critical success to Sustain, the bonus becomes +3.

schema_data.name: Greater Polymath
schema_data.benefit: Versatile Performance now lets you substitute Performance for any skill check (not just Diplomacy, Deception, and Intimidation).

schema_data.name: Allegro
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Composition cantrip: one ally in 60-ft emanation gains a +1 status bonus to Reflex saves and gains the ability to Step as a free action once per turn for as long as you Sustain the Cantrip.

schema_data.name: Shared Assault
schema_data.benefit: While Inspire Courage or Inspire Defense is active, when you critically succeed on an occult spell attack against an enemy, that enemy is flat-footed to the next Strike from an ally that benefits from your composition.

schema_data.name: Studious Capacity
schema_data.benefit: Add 2 additional occult cantrips to your repertoire and increase your spell repertoire known by 1 for your highest available spell rank.

schema_data.name: Deep Lore
schema_data.benefit: Bardic Lore now also lets you identify spells, creatures, and magic items using Occultism as if you had the highest available lore specialization, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to all Lore checks.

schema_data.name: Eternal Composition
schema_data.benefit: You may have three compositions active simultaneously (instead of two). You can Sustain all active compositions with a single Sustain action.

schema_data.name: Melodic Casting
schema_data.benefit: The next two spells you cast this turn can each benefit from the Melodious Spell effect without using separate Metamagic actions.

schema_data.name: Fatal Aria
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Focus spell: target one creature in 30 feet; Will save vs class DC. Critical failure: the creature dies. Failure: the creature is reduced to 0 HP and dying 1. Success: frightened 2. Critical success: unaffected. Frequency: once per day.

schema_data.name: Perfect Encore
schema_data.benefit: When casting a composition spell that is not a cantrip, spend 1 Focus Point to double its effect (as if you spent 2 Focus Points). The composition is cast once and uses one spell slot.

schema_data.name: Pied Piper
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Focus spell: all creatures in 30 feet must attempt a Will save vs your class DC. Failure: they must use their next action to move toward you (or follow you if adjacent). They repeat the save each turn. Critical success ends the effect for that creature.

schema_data.name: Polymath Apex
schema_data.benefit: When using Versatile Performance as a substitute skill, treat your proficiency rank for that skill as Expert (or your Performance proficiency rank, whichever is higher).

schema_data.name: Symphony of the Muse
schema_data.benefit: Cast a composition spell as a free action. This composition does not use up your one-composition-per-turn limit.

schema_data.name: True Facets
schema_data.benefit: Choose a second muse at 20th level. You gain all the muse's granted feat and bonus spell, and access to that muse's feat prerequisites for future feats.

schema_data.name: Basic Lesson: Dreams
schema_data.benefit: You commune with dream spirits. You learn the veil-of-dreams hex. Your familiar learns sleep.

schema_data.name: Basic Lesson: Elements
schema_data.benefit: You call on raw elemental power. You learn the elemental-betrayal hex. Your familiar learns your choice of burning hands, gust of wind, hydraulic push, or pummeling rubble.

schema_data.name: Basic Lesson: Life
schema_data.benefit: You connect with life energy. You learn the life-boost hex. Your familiar learns spirit link.

schema_data.name: Basic Lesson: Protection
schema_data.benefit: You conjure wards against harm. You learn the blood-ward hex. Your familiar learns mage armor.

schema_data.name: Basic Lesson: Vengeance
schema_data.benefit: You call upon retribution. You learn the needle-of-vengeance hex. Your familiar learns phantom pain.

schema_data.name: Greater Lesson: Mischief
schema_data.benefit: You dabble in chaos. You learn the deceiver's-cloak hex. Your familiar learns mad monkeys.

schema_data.name: Greater Lesson: Shadow
schema_data.benefit: You command shadow and darkness. You learn the malicious-shadow hex. Your familiar learns chilling darkness.

schema_data.name: Greater Lesson: Snow
schema_data.benefit: You channel winter's fury. You learn the personal-blizzard hex. Your familiar learns wall of wind.

schema_data.name: Major Lesson: Death
schema_data.benefit: You peer into death itself. You learn the curse-of-death hex. Your familiar learns raise dead.

schema_data.name: Major Lesson: Renewal
schema_data.benefit: You channel renewal and rebirth. You learn the restorative-moment hex. Your familiar learns field of life.

schema_data.name: Alchemical Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You create an alchemical familiar from a base creature using your alchemy skills. It uses INT modifier for Perception, Acrobatics, and Stealth. It counts as an alchemical item for the purpose of infused reagents.

schema_data.name: Alchemical Savant
schema_data.benefit: Identify a held alchemical item as a 1-action (concentrate, manipulate) activity instead of the normal process.

schema_data.name: Far Lobber
schema_data.benefit: Your alchemical bomb range increment becomes 30 feet (default 20 ft).

schema_data.name: Quick Bomber
schema_data.benefit: [1-action] Interact to draw a bomb then Strike with it as one combined action.

schema_data.name: Poison Resistance
schema_data.benefit: Gain poison resistance equal to half your level and a +1 status bonus to saving throws against poison.

schema_data.name: Revivifying Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: [1-action] While under a mutagen, end its duration to regain 1d6 HP per 2 item levels of the mutagen (minimum 1d6).

schema_data.name: Smoke Bomb
schema_data.benefit: [free-action] Trigger: Quick Alchemy to create a bomb of at least 1st level, at least 1 level below advanced alchemy level; frequency once/round. The bomb also creates a cloud of smoke in a 10-foot burst around its detonation point. All creatures in the smoke are concealed until the start of your next turn.

schema_data.name: Calculated Splash
schema_data.benefit: Your bomb splash damage equals your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) instead of the normal amount.

schema_data.name: Efficient Alchemy
schema_data.benefit: When spending downtime to Craft alchemical items, produce twice as many in one batch without additional time and without reducing the number of items produced.

schema_data.name: Enduring Alchemy
schema_data.benefit: Quick Alchemy tools and elixirs remain potent until the end of your next turn (instead of the start of your next turn).

schema_data.name: Combine Elixirs
schema_data.benefit: [free-action] Trigger: Quick Alchemy to create an elixir at least 2 levels below advanced alchemy level; frequency once/round. Add the effects of a second elixir of the same or lower level from your formula book. Consuming the combined elixir grants the effects of both.

schema_data.name: Debilitating Bomb
schema_data.benefit: [free-action] Trigger: Quick Alchemy bomb at least 2 levels below advanced alchemy level; frequency once/round. On a hit, the target is also afflicted with one of: dazzled, deafened, flat-footed, or –5-foot speed penalty until the start of your next turn (your choice).

schema_data.name: Directional Bombs
schema_data.benefit: You can direct bomb splash as a 15-foot cone away from you instead of affecting all adjacent squares.

schema_data.name: Feral Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under a bestial mutagen: gain the mutagen's item bonus to Intimidation; claws and jaws gain the deadly d10 trait.

schema_data.name: Sticky Bomb
schema_data.benefit: [free-action] Trigger: Quick Alchemy bomb at least 2 levels below advanced alchemy level; frequency once/round. A direct hit also deals persistent damage of the bomb's main damage type equal to the bomb's item level.

schema_data.name: Elastic Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under a quicksilver mutagen: you can Step up to 10 feet and can squeeze through spaces as though one size smaller.

schema_data.name: Expanded Splash
schema_data.benefit: Add your Intelligence modifier to splash damage; splash damage affects all creatures within 10 feet of the target instead of 5.

schema_data.name: Greater Debilitating Bomb
schema_data.benefit: Add to the Debilitating Bomb options: clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, stupefied 1, or –10-foot speed penalty until the start of your next turn.

schema_data.name: Merciful Elixir
schema_data.benefit: [free-action] Trigger: Quick Alchemy to create an elixir of life at least 2 levels below advanced alchemy level; frequency once/round. The elixir can also counteract one fear effect or one poison effect of the creature's choice when consumed.

schema_data.name: Potent Poisoner
schema_data.benefit: When crafting poison items, you can increase their DC by up to 4 (maximum: your class DC).

schema_data.name: Extend Elixir
schema_data.benefit: When you drink one of your own infused elixirs (with the elixir and infused traits, and a duration of at least 1 minute), its duration is doubled.

schema_data.name: Invincible Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under a juggernaut mutagen, gain physical damage resistance equal to your Intelligence modifier.

schema_data.name: Uncanny Bombs
schema_data.benefit: Bomb range increment increases to 60 feet; cover circumstance bonus to AC is reduced by 1 against your bombs; you automatically succeed at the flat check to target a concealed creature with a bomb.

schema_data.name: Glib Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under a silvertongue mutagen: ignore circumstance penalties to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, and Performance checks; your lies become more convincing.

schema_data.name: Greater Merciful Elixir
schema_data.benefit: The Merciful Elixir can now also counteract: blinded, deafened, sickened, or slowed.

schema_data.name: True Debilitating Bomb
schema_data.benefit: Debilitating Bomb options now include: enfeebled 2, stupefied 2, and –15-foot speed penalty until end of target's next turn.

schema_data.name: Eternal Elixir
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, consume one of your own infused elixirs of a level no more than half your level: make its duration indefinite (until your next daily preparations). Dismissing the effect is a free action.

schema_data.name: Exploitive Bomb
schema_data.benefit: [free-action] Trigger: Quick Alchemy bomb at least 2 levels below advanced alchemy level; frequency once/round. The bomb reduces the target's resistance to its damage type by an amount equal to the bomb's item level until the start of your next turn.

schema_data.name: Genius Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under a cognitive mutagen: add the mutagen's item bonus to Deception, Diplomacy, Intimidation, Medicine, Nature, Performance, Religion, and Survival checks.

schema_data.name: Persistent Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, when consuming one of your own infused mutagens, retain its effects until your next daily preparations.

schema_data.name: Improbable Elixirs
schema_data.benefit: Select a number of potions of 9th level or lower equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1); gain the formulas to craft them as alchemical elixirs (substituting alchemy for the usual magical process).

schema_data.name: Mindblank Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under a serene mutagen: detection, revelation, and scrying effects of 9th level or lower detect nothing from you, as if you were under a mind blank effect.

schema_data.name: Miracle Worker
schema_data.benefit: Administer a true elixir of life to a creature that has been dead for 2 rounds or fewer; the creature returns to life at 1 HP. This uses up the elixir.

schema_data.name: Perfect Debilitation
schema_data.benefit: Debilitating Bomb conditions can only be avoided on a critical save success (instead of a success or critical success).

schema_data.name: Craft Philosopher's Stone
schema_data.benefit: Gain the formula for the philosopher's stone and add it to your formula book.

schema_data.name: Mega Bomb
schema_data.benefit: [1-action] Requirement: hold an infused bomb of at least 3rd level, at least 3 levels below advanced alchemy level. Throw (Interact action) as part of this activity; bomb affects all creatures within 30 feet of the detonation point (full damage + splash, not just splash). Combine the bomb's full damage and the additive's effects.

schema_data.name: Perfect Mutagen
schema_data.benefit: While under one of your own crafted mutagens, you do not suffer its drawback.

schema_data.name: Acute Vision
schema_data.benefit: While raging, you gain darkvision.

schema_data.name: Moment of Clarity
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] You briefly quell your rage to act clearly. You can use an action that has the concentrate trait (even if concentrate is normally blocked while raging).

schema_data.name: Raging Intimidation
schema_data.benefit: Demoralize and Scare to Death (if you have it) gain the rage trait and can be used while raging. You gain Intimidating Glare as a free bonus feat.

schema_data.name: Raging Thrower
schema_data.benefit: Thrown weapon attacks gain the +2 rage melee damage bonus. For Giant Instinct, thrown oversized weapons deal 6 additional damage.

schema_data.name: Acute Scent
schema_data.benefit: While raging, imprecise scent to a range of 30 feet.

schema_data.name: Furious Finish
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Expend all remaining rounds of Rage duration (minimum 1). Deal maximum weapon damage dice on this Strike. Rage ends immediately after.

schema_data.name: No Escape
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: adjacent enemy moves away from you. Stride to remain adjacent to the triggering enemy (not a free action; this is a reaction Stride).

schema_data.name: Second Wind
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Once per day, recover HP = Barbarian level. If you are dying, stabilize at 0 HP instead and regain 1 HP.

schema_data.name: Shake It Off
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Reduce the value of one condition (persistent damage, frightened, sickened, or slowed) by 1. Reduce persistent damage by 1 additional point if Juggernaut is active.

schema_data.name: Fast Movement
schema_data.benefit: Speed increases by 10 feet while raging.

schema_data.name: Raging Athlete
schema_data.benefit: While raging: Athletics checks benefit from your rage proficiency; you can Climb at your land speed; you can High Jump and Long Jump as if you had rolled 10 on Athletics; and difficult terrain does not reduce jumping distance.

schema_data.name: Swipe
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Make a melee Strike against up to two adjacent foes (each counts as its own Strike for MAP). Apply the same damage roll to both targets.

schema_data.name: Wounded Rage
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: You take damage. Enter a Rage immediately as a reaction (1/day).

schema_data.name: Animal Skin
schema_data.benefit: While raging: your skin hardens; you gain a +2 item bonus to AC if unarmored (or +1 if in light armor).

schema_data.name: Attack of Opportunity
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: enemy within reach makes a manipulate action, moves, or makes a ranged attack. Make a melee Strike against it (MAP applies). If the Strike hits and disrupts a manipulate action, the action is disrupted on a hit (not just critical hit).

schema_data.name: Brutal Bully
schema_data.benefit: While raging, when you successfully Grapple, Shove, or Trip a foe, you deal your Rage melee damage bonus to that foe as bludgeoning damage.

schema_data.name: Cleave
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: you kill or critically hit a foe. Make a melee Strike against an adjacent enemy (MAP applies).

schema_data.name: Dragon's Rage Breath
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Exhale a 30-foot cone of energy matching your dragon type (Reflex save vs class DC). Deal 1d6/level damage (half on success, double on critical failure). Once per rage.

schema_data.name: Spirit's Interference
schema_data.benefit: While raging, a spirit shield protects you: each time you would take physical damage, roll 1d4; on a 1 the spirit fails and damage is normal, otherwise reduce damage by the roll.

schema_data.name: Animal Rage
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Fully transform into your instinct animal (as a 4th-rank animal form). You gain the animal's unarmed attacks, speed, and senses. You can use your Rage action's effects while transformed. Duration: sustained or 1 minute.

schema_data.name: Spirit's Wrath
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Call a spirit to torment a foe. Target: one enemy within 30 feet. Effect: 4d8 negative or positive damage (your choice), Fortitude save vs class DC (half on success, double on critical failure). Once per rage.

schema_data.name: Giant Footprint
schema_data.benefit: While using an oversized weapon while raging, your reach increases by 5 feet. If you are Medium, your reach becomes 10 feet (or 15 feet with a reach weapon).

schema_data.name: Renewed Vigor
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Gain temp HP = half your level + CON modifier (duration until rage ends). This replaces any existing temp HP granted by Rage.

schema_data.name: Share the Pain
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: hit by an enemy's melee Strike. The triggering attacker takes damage equal to your Rage melee damage bonus (bludgeoning, regardless of weapon type).

schema_data.name: Sudden Leap
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Leap (High Jump or Long Jump) and Strike at any point during the jump. If you jumped over an enemy, you can choose that enemy as the target. The leap does not provoke reactions.

schema_data.name: Awesome Blow
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: you critically hit an enemy with a melee Strike while raging. The target must attempt a Fortitude save vs your class DC or be pushed 10 feet and knocked prone (critical failure: 20 feet and prone; success: only 5 feet).

schema_data.name: Giant Stature
schema_data.benefit: While raging with an oversized weapon, your size becomes Large (increasing reach and space). Your oversized weapon grows with you.

schema_data.name: Knockback
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] After a successful melee Strike while raging, attempt a Shove against the same target as a free action (no MAP).

schema_data.name: Terrifying Howl
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Attempt to Demoralize all enemies within 30 feet (single check; each enemy rolls separately). On a success, frightened 1 (frightened 2 on critical success).

schema_data.name: Dragon's Rage Wings
schema_data.benefit: While raging, sprout wings; gain fly speed equal to land speed. Wings retract when rage ends.

schema_data.name: Invulnerable Juggernaut
schema_data.benefit: While raging, gain 2 damage resistance (stacks with Raging Resistance) vs all physical damage types.

schema_data.name: Predator Instinct
schema_data.benefit: Your animal unarmed attacks deal 1d10 damage (upgrading from 1d6/1d4) and gain the Deadly d8 trait.

schema_data.name: Ravager
schema_data.benefit: Critical hits while raging inflict the critical specialization effect of your weapon without needing to have the weapon group mastery. If you already qualify, you may apply an additional effect.

schema_data.name: Come and Get Me
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Until the start of your next turn, enemies that hit you are flat-footed to your next Strike; and when you Strike an enemy that hit you this way, you deal additional damage equal to your Rage melee bonus. You take a –2 AC penalty while this is active.

schema_data.name: Aura of Fury
schema_data.benefit: While raging, allies within 10 feet gain a +1 status bonus to damage rolls (they need not be raging).

schema_data.name: Spirit's Rage
schema_data.benefit: Spirit's Wrath loses the once-per-rage restriction and can be used multiple times per rage.

schema_data.name: Vengeful Strike
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: ally within 60 feet is critically hit. Make a melee Strike against the triggering enemy if it is within your reach (MAP applies).

schema_data.name: Whirlwind Strike
schema_data.benefit: [three-actions] Make one melee Strike against every adjacent creature. Each counts as its own Strike for MAP. Apply the same damage roll to all targets struck.

schema_data.name: Collateral Damage
schema_data.benefit: When you deal damage with a melee Strike while raging, one adjacent creature other than the target takes the damage of your Rage melee bonus (bludgeoning).

schema_data.name: Great Cleave
schema_data.benefit: Cleave can trigger repeatedly: after using Cleave, if that Strike kills or critically hits a foe, you can use Cleave again against another adjacent foe (this can chain until you miss or there are no new adjacent foes).

schema_data.name: Accurate Swing
schema_data.benefit: While raging, your Swipe attack gains the Sweep trait, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on Swipe attacks.

schema_data.name: Impaling Strike
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Make a melee Strike. On a hit, impale the target: it is immobilized and takes 1d8 persistent bleed damage. The target can break free with a DC 20 Athletics check or Escape (it must break or pull the weapon free first). Counts as 2 attacks for MAP.

schema_data.name: Awaken the Inner Monolith
schema_data.benefit: While raging with Giant Stature active, your size becomes Huge for the duration (increasing reach and space further). Your oversized weapon grows with you.

schema_data.name: Apex of Fury
schema_data.benefit: You can use Rage an unlimited number of times per day. The 1-minute cooldown (if you still have it) is removed entirely.

schema_data.name: True Beast
schema_data.benefit: While raging, you can enter true beast form: full animal transformation (Medium or Large) with enhanced attacks. Your instinct unarmed attacks deal 2d6 base damage and gain the Deadly d10 trait.

schema_data.name: Healing Hands
schema_data.benefit: When you cast the heal spell using Divine Font slots or regular slots, the target regains additional HP equal to your level. On a 3-action cast (area heal), each target in the burst gains the bonus.

schema_data.name: Holy Castigation
schema_data.benefit: Combine the power of positive energy with divine punishment. When you cast heal, the spell also deals 1d6 damage to any undead in its area (or to an undead target). This is not subject to the harm resistance undead normally have.

schema_data.name: Harming Hands
schema_data.benefit: When you cast the harm spell using Divine Font slots or regular slots, it deals additional damage equal to your level. On a 3-action cast, each target in the burst takes the bonus damage.

schema_data.name: Deadly Simplicity
schema_data.prerequisites: deity's favored weapon is a simple weapon
schema_data.benefit: Your deity's favored weapon gains the deadly d6 trait (if it already has a deadly trait, increase the deadly die by one step: d6→d8→d10→d12).

schema_data.name: Domain Initiate
schema_data.benefit: Select one domain from your deity's list that you don't already have a domain spell from. You gain the domain's initial domain spell as a focus spell, and your focus pool increases by 1 (max 3).

schema_data.name: Reach Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action is Cast a Spell with a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. Touch spells become 30-foot range.

schema_data.name: Widen Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action is Cast a Spell with a burst/cone/line area (no duration), add 5 ft to a burst radius ≥10 ft, or 5–10 ft to a cone/line.

schema_data.name: Cantrip Expansion
schema_data.benefit: Prepare two additional cantrips each day.

schema_data.name: Communal Healing
schema_data.benefit: When you cast heal targeting a single living creature (not yourself), you regain HP equal to the spell's lowest damage die (minimum 1d6 spell rank → 1d4 hp).

schema_data.name: Emblazon Armament
schema_data.benefit: Spend 10 minutes to emblazon a symbol of your deity on a weapon or shield. The weapon gains the Holy or Unholy trait (matching your deity). The shield grants its bonus to saves vs. evil/good effects (per deity). One item at a time; new use suppresses old.

schema_data.name: Sap Life
schema_data.benefit: When you cast the harm spell and damage at least one creature, you regain HP equal to the spell's level.

schema_data.name: Advanced Domain
schema_data.benefit: Select a domain you have an initial domain spell for. Gain the advanced version of that domain spell as a focus spell. Your focus pool increases by 1 (max 3).

schema_data.name: Channel Smite
schema_data.benefit: [two-actions] Make a melee Strike. If it hits, expend a Divine Font slot to channel the spell through the attack. The target takes the spell's damage in addition to the weapon damage (no attack roll for the spell portion). Applies the higher of the weapon's or spell's save DC.

schema_data.name: Raise Symbol
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Hold your religious symbol aloft. Gain a +2 circumstance bonus to spell attack rolls and saving throws against spells from your deity's opposed alignment until the start of your next turn.

schema_data.name: Steady Spellcasting
schema_data.benefit: Roll DC 15 flat check when a reaction would disrupt a spell you are casting; on a success, the spell is not disrupted.

schema_data.name: Divine Weapon
schema_data.benefit: After casting a spell from your Divine Font, the next Strike with your deity's favored weapon before the start of your next turn deals 1d4 extra damage of a type matching the spell (positive→fire or radiant; negative→cold or void).

schema_data.name: Selective Energy
schema_data.benefit: When you cast heal or harm as a burst, exclude a number of targets up to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1). Those targets are unaffected by the spell.

schema_data.name: Versatile Font
schema_data.prerequisites: deity allows both heal and harm; Healing Font or Harmful Font
schema_data.benefit: You can prepare both heal and harm spells using your Divine Font bonus slots. Half (rounded up) must match your default font type.

schema_data.name: Align Armament
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Imbue one held weapon with your deity's alignment trait (holy or unholy) for 1 minute. The weapon deals 1d6 extra damage of that alignment type vs. creatures of the opposing alignment.

schema_data.name: Castigating Weapon
schema_data.benefit: When you hit an undead creature with your deity's favored weapon, it takes additional positive damage equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

schema_data.name: Heroic Recovery
schema_data.benefit: When you cast a heal spell of 3rd level or higher on a creature at 0 HP, it can attempt a recovery check as a free action before standing up from unconscious.

schema_data.name: Replenishing Strike
schema_data.benefit: When you kill an enemy with a melee Strike while your Divine Font is active, regain 1 Divine Font slot (max 1 per day total). This ability recharges at daily preparations.

schema_data.name: Shared Replenishment
schema_data.benefit: When Communal Healing triggers, the healing passes to the ally you healed, not just to yourself. Your ally regains the additional HP instead.

schema_data.name: Divine Rebuttal
schema_data.benefit: [reaction] Trigger: you critically succeed on a saving throw against a magical effect. Counteract the triggering spell as a free action (your divine spell DC vs. the spell's DC). Frequency: once per 10 minutes.

schema_data.name: Echoing Channel
schema_data.benefit: When you use Channel Smite, create a secondary 5-foot burst centered on the target that deals half the spell's damage to all creatures in the burst (basic save vs. your divine DC).

schema_data.name: Emblazon Energy
schema_data.benefit: Your emblazoned weapon also deals 1d4 persistent fire (Holy) or void (Unholy) damage on a critical hit, in addition to its normal effects.

schema_data.name: Use Elixir
schema_data.benefit: [one-action] Use a held potion or elixir on a willing adjacent creature as a 1-action Interact instead of the normal 2-action process.

schema_data.name: Avatar's Audience
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, spend 1 minute in prayer to receive a brief divine vision from your deity equivalent to contact other plane (automatic success; no save required; deity can answer up to 6 yes/no questions).

schema_data.name: Extended Channel
schema_data.benefit: When casting heal or harm using a 3-action version (burst), the burst radius increases from 30 to 60 feet.

schema_data.name: Swift Banishment
schema_data.benefit: [free action] Trigger: you critically hit a creature with a Strike. You can cast a prepared banishment spell targeting the creature as a free action; expend a spell slot of the appropriate level.

schema_data.name: Avatar
schema_data.benefit: Spend 1 Focus Point to transform into an avatar of your deity for 1 minute. You grow to Large size, sprout divine wings (fly speed 60 ft), gain a +2 status bonus to AC, and gain access to two divine strikes aligned with your deity. This uses all your remaining Focus Points when activated. Frequency: once per day.

schema_data.name: Miracle
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, petition your deity to duplicate the effects of any divine spell of 9th rank or lower (even one you haven't prepared) without expending a spell slot. Your deity grants the miracle if it aligns with their portfolio; otherwise the request fails harmlessly.

schema_data.name: Animal Companion
schema_data.benefit: You gain the service of a young animal companion. See the animal companions rules. Animal Order druids receive this feat for free at level 1.

schema_data.name: Leshy Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You gain a leshy as a familiar with the standard familiar rules. Leaf Order druids receive this for free. A leshy familiar can regain the plant trait and gains +1 Hit Point per your level.

schema_data.name: Reach Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. If the spell has a range of touch, it gains a range of 30 feet.

schema_data.name: Widen Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell with a burst/cone/line area, increase the area by 5 feet (burst radius ≥ 10 ft) or 5–10 feet (cone/line).

schema_data.name: Order Explorer
schema_data.benefit: You join a second druidic order, gaining access to its 1st-level order feats. You gain the Focus Point(s) of that order but do not gain its order spell. Violating that order's anathema removes its feats but not your main primal connection.

schema_data.name: Storm Born
schema_data.benefit: You don't take penalties from natural weather conditions and are not buffeted or blinded by wind. Creatures don't gain circumstance bonuses to AC against your ranged attacks in weather conditions.

schema_data.name: Wild Shape
schema_data.benefit: You gain the wild shape order spell. Wild Order druids gain +1 Focus Point and can cast wild shape once per hour without expending a spell slot.

schema_data.name: Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You gain a familiar using the standard familiar rules.

schema_data.name: Goodberry
schema_data.benefit: You gain the goodberry order spell. You can call upon the bounty of nature to create a magical berry that restores vitality and can sustain a creature.

schema_data.name: Heal Animal
schema_data.benefit: You gain the heal animal order spell, healing your animal companion or other animals with focused primal energy.

schema_data.name: Tempest Surge
schema_data.benefit: You gain the tempest surge order spell; surround a foe with a tiny storm that buffets and crackles with lightning.

schema_data.name: Steady Spellcasting
schema_data.benefit: If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting, attempt a DC 15 flat check. On a success the spell is not disrupted.

schema_data.name: Call of the Wild
schema_data.benefit: You can spend 10 minutes to call a creature with the animal, elemental, or plant trait to serve you for 24 hours (as summon animal). The creature obeys commands and departs after the duration.

schema_data.name: Enhanced Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You infuse your familiar with more primal energy. Your familiar gains 2 additional familiar abilities.

schema_data.name: Ferocious Shape
schema_data.benefit: You can take the form of a Large animal. Your wild shape forms include Large forms such as tigers, bears, and dire wolves.

schema_data.name: Soaring Shape
schema_data.benefit: You gain the ability to take winged forms, granting a fly speed. Your wild shape forms now include birds, bats, and pterosaurs.

schema_data.name: Wind Caller
schema_data.benefit: You gain the stormwind flight order spell; conjure winds to soar through the air.

schema_data.name: Current Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell with an electricity or cold trait, increase the spell's range by 30 feet; if the spell has a range of touch, it gains a range of 30 feet.

schema_data.name: Green Empathy
schema_data.benefit: You can use Wild Empathy on plant creatures as well as animals. Mindless plants are immune.

schema_data.name: Insect Shape
schema_data.benefit: You can take Tiny insect forms. Your wild shape forms now include ants, scorpions, spiders, and similar Tiny vermin.

schema_data.name: Mature Animal Companion
schema_data.benefit: Your animal companion grows up, gaining the mature template.

schema_data.name: Storm Retribution
schema_data.benefit: Trigger: a creature deals damage to you with a melee attack. Use tempest surge against the creature as a reaction, expending 1 Focus Point.

schema_data.name: Aerial Form
schema_data.benefit: Your aerial wild shape forms are more powerful. You gain an additional aerial form with improved statistics and speed.

schema_data.name: Timeless Nature
schema_data.benefit: Nature ages you more slowly. You no longer take aging penalties to your ability scores and can't die of old age.

schema_data.name: Thousand Faces
schema_data.benefit: You can use wild shape to take the form of any Small or Medium humanoid in addition to your animal forms.

schema_data.name: Woodland Stride
schema_data.benefit: You move through undergrowth and natural difficult terrain without any penalty to your Speed and don't trigger hazards from natural plants.

schema_data.name: Overwhelming Energy
schema_data.benefit: Your primal energy overwhelms resistances. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, the spell ignores up to 10 points of resistance to its damage type.

schema_data.name: Plant Shape
schema_data.benefit: You can take the form of plant creatures when using wild shape. You can transform into any small or medium plant creature.

schema_data.name: Primal Focus
schema_data.benefit: You can refocus twice in a single day (normally you can only refocus once to restore 1 Focus Point). Each refocus still restores only 1 Focus Point.

schema_data.name: Specialized Companion
schema_data.benefit: Your animal companion gains one specialization from: bully, defender, racer, scout, or tracker.

schema_data.name: Elemental Shape
schema_data.benefit: You can take the form of elemental beings. You can transform into Small, Medium, or Large earth, fire, air, or water elementals using wild shape.

schema_data.name: Pristine Weapon
schema_data.benefit: The weapons you wield are treated as cold iron and silver for the purposes of overcoming damage resistance, as if they had those material properties.

schema_data.name: Storm Order Resilience
schema_data.benefit: You gain resistance 10 to electricity. You gain the swim speed 30 ft if you don't already have it.

schema_data.name: Dragon Shape
schema_data.benefit: You can take the form of a dragon using wild shape. You transform into a Large dragon gaining a powerful bite and claws, breath weapon, and flight speed.

schema_data.name: True Shapeshifter
schema_data.benefit: Once per day as a single action, you can change into a different wild shape form without needing to dismiss and re-cast the spell.

schema_data.name: Monstrosity Shape
schema_data.benefit: You can take the forms of legendary creatures. You can transform into a Gargantuan form, gaining immense size and power.

schema_data.name: Primal Wellspring
schema_data.benefit: You can refocus three times per day. Each refocus restores 1 Focus Point.

schema_data.name: Invoke Disaster
schema_data.benefit: You gain the invoke disaster order spell. Call down the full fury of a natural disaster on your foes.

schema_data.name: Perfect Form Control
schema_data.benefit: When using wild shape, you retain the ability to cast spells if the form allows it. You ignore the –2 spell level penalty from metamagic applied to wild shape.

schema_data.name: Nature's Aegis
schema_data.benefit: The natural world protects you. You gain regeneration 5 (deactivated by fire or acid). Increase your resistance to physical damage from natural sources (animals, plants, elementals) by 10.

schema_data.name: Leyline Conduit
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, you can attune to nearby ley lines. For 10 minutes you can cast any primal spell you have prepared as if you had one additional spell slot at the highest spell level you can cast.

schema_data.name: Dangerous Sorcery
schema_data.benefit: Your legacy of magical power grants you great destructive force. When you Cast a Spell from your spell slots, if the spell deals damage and doesn't have a duration, add a bonus to the damage equal to the spell's rank.

schema_data.name: Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting. You gain a familiar.

schema_data.name: Reach Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell's range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet.

schema_data.name: Widen Spell
schema_data.benefit: If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has an area of a burst, cone, or line and doesn't have a duration, increase the area of that spell. Add 5 feet to the radius of a burst (≥ 10 ft radius) or 5–10 feet to the length of a cone or line.

schema_data.name: Cantrip Expansion
schema_data.benefit: A greater understanding of your magic broadens your range of simple spells. Add 2 additional cantrips to your spell repertoire from your bloodline's spell list.

schema_data.name: Enhanced Familiar
schema_data.benefit: You infuse your familiar with additional magical energy. Your familiar gains 2 additional familiar abilities.

schema_data.name: Steady Spellcasting
schema_data.benefit: If a reaction would disrupt your spellcasting action, attempt a DC 15 flat check. On a success, the action is not disrupted.

schema_data.name: Arcane Evolution
schema_data.benefit: You have adapted your bloodline magic to function as an arcane tradition. You gain one additional spell in your repertoire of any level you can cast (chosen from the arcane list). Each time you gain a spell slot of a new rank, you add one arcane spell of that rank to your repertoire.

schema_data.name: Crossblooded Evolution
schema_data.benefit: You add one spell from a bloodline other than your own to your spell repertoire. This spell must be on your bloodline's tradition's spell list. You don't gain the other bloodline's blood magic or granted spells; you gain only this one spell.

schema_data.name: Bloodline Breadth
schema_data.benefit: Your magical heritage encompasses an even wider range of bloodline spells. Add 1 spell of each level you can cast from your bloodline's granted spell list to your spell repertoire (this adds 1 spell per spell rank, not one total).

schema_data.name: Instinctive Obfuscation
schema_data.benefit: As a reaction (trigger: a creature targets you with a spell), you automatically attempt to Misdirect the spell toward a different target within range, using Deception against the caster's Perception DC.

schema_data.name: Greater Bloodline
schema_data.benefit: Your bloodline grows even more powerful. You gain an additional bloodline spell of the highest rank you can currently cast and add it to your repertoire; this spell gains the blood magic benefit whenever you cast it.

schema_data.name: Overwhelming Energy
schema_data.benefit: Your primal power overwhelms resistances. If the next action you take is to Cast a Spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, the spell ignores up to 10 points of resistance to its damage type.

schema_data.name: Quickened Casting
schema_data.benefit: Once per day, if your next action is to Cast a Spell of 3rd level or lower, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action). You can't use this with a spell that already has a reduced casting time.

schema_data.name: Greater Mental Evolution
schema_data.benefit: You gain one 6th- or lower-level mental spell from any tradition in your spell repertoire. You can cast this spell once per day as a bloodline spell, using your bloodline tradition.

schema_data.name: Bloodline Resistance
schema_data.benefit: Your bloodline magic protects your mind and body. You gain resistance 10 to the damage type associated with your bloodline's blood magic effect.

schema_data.name: True Blood
schema_data.benefit: Your bloodline magic has reached its full potential. When you cast a bloodline spell, the blood magic effect automatically triggers and can apply both to you and to the spell's target simultaneously (rather than choosing one).

schema_data.name: Bloodline Conduit
